authority.rule: Never override AI Premium Shop catalog eligibility, local price, access model, payment, delivery, refund or warranty, review, provider authorization, or other protected commercial truth.

plus.positioning: ChatGPT Plus provides broader model and tool access than Free, with higher model limits and advanced reasoning access. Exact model availability and usage limits can change over time.

go.official_reference: Check OpenAI's current pricing page for the country and currency shown to the buyer
go.positioning: ChatGPT Go is a lower-cost individual plan with expanded access to popular ChatGPT tools compared with Free. OpenAI says Go is available in countries where ChatGPT is supported, while pricing can vary by country and currency and can change over time.
features: Higher usage limits for eligible ChatGPT features than Free
Projects, tasks, custom GPTs and Library subject to current availability and limits
caveats: Some advanced products and higher-tier features may require Plus or another eligible plan
API usage is not included and is billed independently
Usage remains subject to plan limits, abuse guardrails and temporary restrictions during high demand

pro.positioning: OpenAI currently documents two ChatGPT Pro tiers. The $100 tier has 5x higher usage than Plus and the $200 tier has 20x higher usage than Plus; model-specific allowances can still apply.

business.official_reference: Standard: $25/user monthly or $20/user/month billed annually; Premium: $125/user monthly or $100/user/month billed annually
business.billing: Monthly or annual billing at the workspace level
business.positioning: ChatGPT Business is a self-serve team workspace. OpenAI currently requires at least two paid seats, allows Standard and Premium seats to be mixed, and supports up to 200 paid seats for current workspaces.
features: Standard and Premium paid seat types can be mixed in one workspace
Standard seats include ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex subject to current included limits
Premium seats provide a higher usage allotment than Standard
Current workspaces support 2 to 200 paid Standard and Premium seats combined
caveats: At least two paid Standard or Premium seats are required for a new Business workspace
Prices listed by OpenAI are in USD and may vary by country and currency
API usage is separate from the Business workspace subscription and billed independently
OpenAI plan structure, included usage and workspace limits can change over time

account_policy.statement: OpenAI says an account is meant for the individual who created it and another person should create their own account.

local_payment.rule: These are AI Premium Shop public payment references, not a claim about payment methods accepted directly by OpenAI.
